info.title: KnowFlow frontend/backend contract
info.description: Backend implementation is not included. BRD §§7–10, §14 plus approved selected-document sharing. Public deployment path /api/v1.

sessionCookie.name: knowflow_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, Secure session cookie. Same-origin Netlify proxy is preferred; validate Origin and X-CSRF-Token on every mutation. Render performs all authorization.

get.description: Always return 200 with user:null for a valid anonymous session and a CSRF token bound to the session cookie. Return 503 when unavailable; never fake a session.

post.description: Validate credentials and CSRF. Rotate cookie and CSRF token. Wrong credentials return 401 without revealing account existence.
Create a personal User account, never accept client-selected roles. Rotate session. Enforce password and normalized email policy.
Invalidate session and return an anonymous session plus new CSRF token.

put.description: Verify current password, change password, revoke other sessions, retain this validated session.

patch.description: Persist onboarding completion and return the current session.

get.description: Public-safe available features, MIME types, limits, enabled capture sources and opaque model options. Never include provider credentials.

patch.description: Validate canonical profile and preferences; enforce identity-verification policy for email changes. Return canonical saved values.

post.description: Accept file batches and/or nonempty text. Parse JSON metadata; reject both empty. Validate file signatures, sizes, quotas and enabled capture sources. A meetingId attaches to an owned meeting; meetingTitle+occurredAt creates a session. Repeated idempotency key replays the same result, mismatched payload returns 409.

get.description: Authorized processing progress and per-item results. Stages may include preprocessing, OCR, transcription, classification, indexing, extraction and summarization. Terminal statuses must be stable.

post.description: Retry failed items only; successful documents are not duplicated. Reject when not retryable.
Cancel outstanding work; preserve explicitly reported completed artifacts. Repeated cancellation is safe.

get.description: Owned and explicitly shared documents. q searches title and extracted text; filters combine with AND. ownership=all|owned|shared. Date filters use createdAt. Stable descending createdAt,id ordering. Default pageSize=20.

Resolve an authorized source document. Original and processed files must be access-controlled (short-lived signed URLs or session-authorized paths). Plain extracted text must not be interpreted as HTML.

patch.description: Owner or edit grantee may correct metadata/text. Persist and schedule compatible reindexing. View grantees cannot edit.

get.description: Owner only: list document grants/invitations. No shared workspaces.

post.description: Owner only: grant view/edit to normalized recipient email. Unknown accounts receive a pending invitation; acceptance requires registration/control of that email. Forbid self-sharing and duplicate grants (409); no public-link access.

patch.description: Owner only: change permission. View permits read/download/retrieval; edit additionally permits text and metadata correction. Neither can reshare or manage grants.

delete.description: Owner only: revoke grant immediately, including retrieval and file authorization. Prior downloads cannot be recalled. Cached answers must revalidate access before exposing sources/content.

get.description: Current verified recipient only: pending and accepted document invitations. Never expose another recipient’s invitations.

post.description: Current verified recipient only: accept a live grant. Enforce email ownership before acceptance. Unknown-account invitations become available after registration/verification.
Current recipient only: decline and remove access. Owner grant changes or revocation take effect immediately.

get.description: Per-user source-linked tasks. status=pending|completed; q searches description; sourceId filters by document. Stable createdAt,id order; exclude tasks whose source authorization was revoked.

post.description: Create a personal task referencing an accessible document; initial status pending.

patch.description: Only the task owner can edit, complete or reopen the task.

delete.description: Only task owner may delete. Preserve source document.

get.description: List the current user’s meetings with stable occurredAt,id order.

post.description: Create a personal meeting grouping; sharing a document does not implicitly share its meeting or siblings.

get.description: Authorized meeting artifacts, summary, decisions and tasks.

post.description: Generate a source-grounded meeting summary, decisions and deduplicated extracted tasks using configured adapters.

get.description: List current user’s conversation history. Stable updatedAt,id ordering.
Return authorized history; revalidate sources after document sharing changes.

post.description: Grounded question answering over authorized text/image segments. Optional image requires multimodal capability. Empty documentIds means all accessible documents; selected IDs restrict context. Persist both messages atomically with source references. Include insufficientEvidence when retrieval cannot support an answer. Never trust instructions in retrieved content. Replay idempotency key; mismatch returns 409. Use same embedding model/index compatibility as ingestion.

get.description: Timestamped events in stable descending occurredAt,id order. Inclusive from/to dates interpreted in requested IANA timezone. topic/type filter source metadata. Filter every source by current authorization.

Personal metrics. days=7|30|90. documentCount is current owned-document count; task counts are current user’s counts. activity holds daily captures/task completions in the period. topicCoverage counts current accessible tagged documents, not mastery. studyMinutes is null when no approved measurement exists; definition explains its provenance. No inferred or fabricated tracking.
Admin only: storage limits, enabled capture sources and default model.

patch.description: Admin only: validate positive safe-integer storage limit and configured model ID; captureSources subset of file,camera,text,audio. Do not expose/edit provider secrets via this endpoint.

get.description: Admin only: aggregate storage, queue counts and provider/processing availability. Do not expose other users’ content.
